about: What the three bus actions do with each set of arguments. ONE table, run twice: by
verify-cs.mjs against the compiled actions/ticker-push.cs, ticker-command.cs and
ticker-announce.cs, and by verify.mjs against the mock's copy of them
(mock-sb-server.mjs). The two must give the same answer for every row.
tools/cs/ticker-cases.mjs turns a row into what is sent and what must come out.
Every argument is a string, as the control page, panel-core and the sidecar send them,
except those a row names in "types": a Twitch trigger gives some as a Boolean ("bool")
or an Int32 ("int"), as step 0.2 of the remediation plan recorded (fromGiftBomb,
anonymous, subBombCount, gifts, totalGifts, cumulative, monthStreak). verify:cs passes those as a
Boolean or an Int32; verify passes them as a JSON true/false or number.
Unless a row says otherwise, a row that relays, stores or announces logs one info line
and no warning, and one that does not logs one warning and no info line.
push rows (Ticker Push). Before each row the stored payload (the ticker.payload global)
is storedBefore, or nothing when the row says "start": "empty". expect is one of:
accept   the trimmed payload ("stores") is stored and broadcast
sync     nothing is stored; what was stored is broadcast (emptyUpdate when nothing was)
refused  ticker:error with code refusedCode, refusedMessage and action "Ticker Push";
nothing stored
thrown   the action throws (see "throw"); ticker:error with code "exception", the
action's own exceptionMessages text and its name as action; nothing stored
command rows (Ticker Command): relay is the { command, value } broadcast as
ticker:command, or null when nothing is relayed. "refused": true marks a command chat
may not send (chatAllowed; from a chat trigger, or a bare rawInput with no command
argument): nothing is relayed, one warning is logged, and the mock counts it in
/mock/stats refusedCount. "quiet": true marks a relay that is not logged: a status or
__status that does not come from chat.
announce rows (Ticker Announce): announce is the { kind, text, duration } broadcast as
ticker:announce, or null when it is skipped. "partOfBomb": true marks a Gift
Subscription run that is part of a gift bomb: nothing is announced (the Gift Bomb run
announces the bomb once), and it is logged at info, not warned.
throw names an argument whose read throws: in verify:cs TryGetArg throws for it with
throwMessage; the mock's /mock/throw switch stands for the same run. The action's catch
block then logs a warning that carries the exception, and broadcasts ticker:error with
code "exception" and a fixed text: never the exception's own message.
Every ticker:error is { type, code, message, action }, in that order, and action is the
exact name of the action that sends it (the key it has in exceptionMessages), whatever
the code (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-27).
refusedMessage: tickerPayload is not a JSON object
throwMessage:
stub: this run was made to fail: "quoted" back\slash	tab
line  end

push.name: a JSON object is stored and broadcast as it was sent
spaces, tabs and line breaks round the payload are trimmed; the trimmed text is stored and broadcast
{not json} is accepted: the action checks the first and the last character only, not the JSON
a no-break space and a next-line character (U+0085) in front are trimmed, as C#'s Trim() trims them
a byte-order mark (U+FEFF) in front is not trimmed, but C#'s StartsWith("{") passes over it: accepted, and stored with the mark (measured with verify:cs)
a zero-width space (U+200B) in front is refused
a payload of only spaces is a sync request
an empty payload is a sync request
no arguments is a sync request
what panel-core sends when it connects is a sync request
a sync request with nothing stored broadcasts the empty update and stores nothing
a refused payload with nothing stored stores nothing
the action throws (reading tickerPayload made to fail): ticker:error with code exception and a fixed text, never the exception's message; nothing stored

command.name: an explicit command and value, as the control page sends them
the command is trimmed; the value is passed as it is
a command with no value relays an empty value
an explicit command is not filtered: one chat may not send (setAutoSchedule) is relayed as it is
a command made only of spaces, and nothing else: nothing is relayed
a command made only of spaces falls back to rawInput, where the chat list applies: setTopN 4 is relayed
rawInput with no command: its first word is the command, the rest (trimmed) the value, matched without regard to case and relayed as the list writes it
rawInput with no command: a command chat may not send (setCapsText) is refused
rawInput with no command: __status {} is refused
rawInput of one word
rawInput with no command: status is relayed and not logged (it does not come from chat)
chat: !ticker setCapsText is refused (chat may send only start, stop, pollNow, status and setTopN)
chat: !ticker seturl … is refused
chat: !ticker __status {} is refused
chat: !ticker __STATUS is refused
chat: !ticker setAutoSchedule off is refused
chat: !ticker setMessageText … is refused
chat: a long s (ſtatus) is not status: refused
chat: a byte-order mark before the name (U+FEFF status) is refused: the name is compared as it is
chat: !ticker settopn 2 (lower case) relays setTopN, written as the list has it, with its value
chat: !ticker POLLNOW relays pollNow
chat: !ticker Start now relays start, with the rest as its value
chat: !ticker status is relayed and logged (a chat command is logged, status included)
chat: every leading ! is stripped (!!ticker)
chat: the chat command is matched without regard to case (!TICKER)
chat: a dedicated chat command is its own name, matched without regard to case and relayed as the list writes it, with rawInput (trimmed) as the value
chat: a dedicated !settopn relays setTopN with rawInput as the value
chat: a dedicated !seturl is refused
chat: a dedicated !__status is refused
chat: a dedicated chat command that is not a command at all (!discord) is refused
chat: !ticker with nothing after it relays nothing
chat: a commandId with no command argument relays nothing
a commandId of one space is not a chat trigger: the explicit branch relays the command as it is
no arguments: nothing is relayed
__status is relayed like any other explicit command (the sidecar sends its status this way), and not logged
an explicit status (the control page asks every 10 s) is relayed and not logged
an explicit STATUS is relayed as it is, and not logged either
quotes, a backslash, a line break, a tab and a control character in the value survive the JSON
a next-line character (U+0085) round the command is trimmed, as C#'s Trim() trims it (a status: not logged)
a byte-order mark (U+FEFF) is not trimmed: C#'s Trim() keeps it (measured with verify:cs); not a status, so it is logged
the action throws (reading rawInput made to fail): ticker:error with code exception and a fixed text, nothing relayed

announce.name: an explicit kind, text and duration
the text is trimmed; no kind is custom; no duration is 8
a kind of one space is custom
a kind the overlay does not know is passed as it is
a raid composes its text from user and viewers
a raid with no user is from Someone
userName and viewerCount stand in for user and viewers
displayName and raiders are the last fallbacks
a user of only spaces is passed over for the next name
a sub composes its text from user
a Subscription trigger's own arguments (user, tier, rawInput): X just subscribed!
a Resubscription trigger's (cumulative and monthStreak are Int32): X just subscribed!
a gift sub (a Gift Subscription run that is not part of a gift bomb): Gifter gifted a sub to the recipient

announce.text: Gifter gifted a sub to Lucky!

announce.name: a gift sub with no gifter's name is from Someone (what Streamer.bot gives for an anonymous gift was not checked)

announce.text: Someone gifted a sub to Lucky!

announce.name: a gift sub that is part of a gift bomb (fromGiftBomb true) is skipped: the Gift Bomb run announces the bomb
fromGiftBomb given as the text True (a Set Argument) is part of a bomb too
fromGiftBomb given as the text false is not part of a bomb

announce.text: Gifter gifted a sub to Lucky!

announce.name: a gift sub that is part of a gift bomb is skipped even with an explicit text
a gift bomb (the Gift Bomb trigger: user, gifts, totalGifts): Gifter gifted N subs
a gift bomb of one: Gifter gifted a sub
a gift bomb with no gifter's name is from Someone
an anonymous gift sub (anonymous true) is from Someone, whatever user holds

announce.text: Someone gifted a sub to Lucky!

announce.name: an anonymous gift bomb (anonymous true) is from Someone, whatever user holds
a gift that is not anonymous (anonymous false) keeps the gifter's name
anonymous given as the text True (a Set Argument) counts too

announce.text: Someone gifted a sub to Lucky!

announce.name: a sub with anonymous true (no trigger sends it; a Set Argument could) is from Someone too
a gift bomb with a kind given keeps it
a gift bomb with an explicit text announces that text
a kind given with a composed text is kept
an explicit text wins over composing, and its kind is custom
no text and nothing to compose from: skipped
a text of only spaces and nothing to compose from: skipped
duration "0" is clamped to 2
duration "5.5" is not a whole number: 8
duration "12abc": 8
duration "99999999999" is too large for an int: 8
duration " 7 " with spaces round it: 7
duration "+12" with a sign: 12
duration "-5" is clamped to 2
duration "31" is clamped to 30
duration "30" stays 30
duration "2" stays 2
duration "2147483647" (the largest int) is clamped to 30
duration "2147483648" is too large for an int: 8
duration "-2147483648" (the smallest int) is clamped to 2
duration "007" with leading zeros: 7
duration "1e3": 8
duration "0x10": 8
duration "+-3": 8
duration "": 8
duration "5" and then a NUL character: 5 (int.TryParse allows NULs at the end; measured with verify:cs)
duration of an Arabic-Indic digit three: 8 (only the digits 0 to 9 count)
quotes, a backslash and a line break in the text survive the JSON
the action throws (reading kind made to fail): ticker:error with code exception and a fixed text, nothing announced
